body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 3 units. Until your next turn, gain +1 Defense against the next Action it uses against you.

surges.html: Increase one range, Defense penalty, or trigger distance from this card by 1.
If this card establishes a Contingency, it may trigger one additional time before expiring. This Surge may be used only once.

rider.title: REVERSAL CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The chosen creature targets you. Effect: After its Action resolves, it becomes Exposed.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
